reviews.title: Best Purchase
reviews.comment: Not much else can be said about this card except it's everything you want and then some. It can handle anything that I throw at it in 1440p. With FSR 4.1, I regularly see 500+ fps paired with the 9800x3d. Temps stay cool under 65c, even during the longest gaming sessions. Card is fairly compact compared to other brands, with the total length less than 2 inches longer than a standard ATX mobo. Fans stay quiet as well. Has a nice subtle RGB accent on the front that can be changed in the control center software. Great performance, great look. Well worth the price.
reviews.author: Ricky Bridger

reviews.title: Worth the upgrade
reviews.comment: card is an absolute beast , upgrading from a 6800 XT and the difference is night and day . thermals are amazing in the titles i play , with solid fps at 4k couldnt be happier . one thing you have be sure to buy is a psu with 4 or more 2x6 pcie ports , becuase this big boy takes 3. i grabbed the rm1000x has more than enough ports and head room .
reviews.author: Samantha Pagan

reviews.title: Best dollar for dollar performance for a GPU for gaming.
reviews.comment:
My order was never received due to a shipping error. However, Amazon was able to resolve this on their end. I was able to snag this card at my local micro center and get it back home in my rig. Let me just say that I have a 9950x3d and a 5090 in one of my rigs. This rig is also running a 9950x3d and this card. The 5090 still blows it out of the water on raw performance, but this card is probably the best dollar for dollar performance you can get in a gaming card today. Definitely snag one before price hikes start too much - it's very good. I ended up putting Bazzite on my rig and it's buttery smooth and dead quiet for a couch PC build. Temps are great. Video card only really gets loud when compiling shaders but I'm able to play nearly everything in my library at 4k60 on my TV with no issues. 1440p I was getting 240fps with no framegen on Hogwarts legacy, 150fps at 1440p in cyberpunk. Horizon Zero Dawn ran about the same. All on max settings. FSR isn't bad where it exists, and the scaling stuff is pretty incredible to squeeze a few more frames out if you run into any stuttering; which I haven't yet. This thing is just a great buy. I'll say the CPU does matter some but the 9950x3d is slightly overkill. It won't be my bottleneck for a while.
Pick it up. I wasn't able to enjoy it right away but glad I was able to find it in stock locally to me. Figured I owed a review here as well as on the micro center site. Cheers.
reviews.author: Quin C

reviews.title: Best gpu price to performance!!
reviews.comment: Awesome gpu I can rest easy knowing I can play whatever game I want on max settings at 1080p and get a solid 4k experience in most titles. The temps and performance on this thing are great! I could not ask for a better gpu.
reviews.author: will robertrson

reviews.title: 1440p killer
reviews.comment: Amazing gpu, great performance. Handles 1440p like a piece of cake. This card is LOUD tho if you want to crank the fan speeds to keep it cool. Runs a lot louder than other 9070xt under the same loads/temps.
